checks.quote: # Proposed study: isogenic acute-loss/rescue test of p53-dependent G1 arrest
checks.reason: No-pulse and cellular controls do not provide assay-specific DNA detector linearity/compensation, positive death-detection calibration and quantitative accuracy/recovery acceptance/failure rules.

checks.quote: Reject or repeat a batch if
checks.reason: Rejection for high post-treatment death or differential initial injury can discard valid biological outcomes. These require retained denominators and an explicit inconclusive result, followed by a separate redesigned study, not batch removal under technical eligibility.

checks.quote: control multiplicity for the prespecified necessity and rescue tests
checks.reason: No actual correction/gatekeeping procedure is supplied; tracking loss is also treated as censoring without an informative-loss sensitivity/bounding rule. Mixed models alone do not resolve those assumptions.

checks.quote: Test a range of doses and exposure durations
checks.reason: No bounded dose/time/caffeine range or explicit range-expansion/stopping procedure before confirmation, despite useful viability and endpoint-selection targets.

checks.quote: positive necessity contrast
checks.reason: A positive intact-minus-depleted interaction demonstrates contribution, not necessity if substantial damage-induced arrest remains after depletion. The decision lacks a negligible-residual-response criterion despite requiring rescue equivalence.

checks.quote: gates and analysis code were locked
checks.reason: Analysis locking does not preserve linked raw files, cell/well IDs, exact code/environment/settings and processing outputs.
